concerns.text: SC‑001 (R² ≥ 0.6 on the held‑out test set) is not verified by any task. Existing tasks (T039, T040, T021_verify) only check artifact existence, not that the R² meets the success threshold.
SC‑002 (|r| ≥ 0.5 on the held‑out test set) lacks a verification task. No task asserts that the Pearson correlation meets the required magnitude.

SC‑003 (permutation‑importance p‑value < 0.05) is not explicitly enforced. T044 ensures a “sufficiently large” permutation count, and T211 verifies schema compliance, but no task checks that the corrected p‑values satisfy the < 0.05 criterion.

FR‑005 requires exactly 1 000 permutations per descriptor. Task T044 mentions “sufficiently large number of permutations” without specifying 1 000, and T210 does not state the count. No task guarantees the mandated 1 000‑permutation budget.
SC‑009 (achieved power ≥ 0.80) is not validated. T030 performs power analysis and T030_verify checks schema conformity, but no task asserts that the power meets the ≥ 0.80 threshold.
Task T007a and its verification T007a_verify are tagged with [FR‑007] (unknown‑element handling), but FR‑007 does not exist in spec.md, making the tag stale.
